single_factor_variants.qty-two: Only POS-B MaterielStructure QTYPM=2 relative to same-seed baseline
single_factor_variants.env-two: Only POS-B MaterielStructure ENVF=2.0 relative to same-seed baseline

pre_run_hypothesis: For each matched seed, native aggregate SystemResults NFAIL and NREPT will be measured across all 72 half-hour bins. If documented MaterielStructure frequency propagation applies, each factor intervention should raise the seed-panel mean NFAIL relative to baseline. The first-replication event log is provenance and position evidence, not an aggregate estimator.

pre_run_analysis.primary_outcome: Sum SystemResults NFAIL for the total unit/system across 72 nonoverlapping half-hour bins, reported as failures per 256 replications for each seed and arm.
pre_run_analysis.uncertainty: Across the twelve predeclared matched seeds, report each paired difference, the arithmetic mean, sample standard deviation, and Student t 95% interval. Use an exact one-sided sign test for positive differences with Bonferroni threshold 0.025 per contrast. Zero differences count as nonpositive. Report the count of positive seeds and exact p value.
pre_run_analysis.acceptance_direction: Both contrasts require positive mean difference and exact sign-test p < 0.025. Report magnitude descriptively without claiming an exact doubling or equivalence between interventions.

acceptance_requires: All 36 executions pass guarded session-0 SSH and host-wide Issue #18 mutex with GUI PID 13340 continuity.
Four native steps, exact populated-table roundtrip, zero conversion errors and nonempty valid report/log for every execution.
Source and twelve raw evidence files per run sealed with invocation and closure hashes.
Independent read-only replay of all source, raw, outcomes and statistical contrasts.
limitations: Seed-matched aggregate counts do not establish exact physical replacement multiplicity, identical QTYPM and ENVF mechanisms, or population behavior outside the stated model and panel.
The ENLOG records only the first replication within each 256-replication run.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
